references.text: God gives instructions to make a curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle, with the same materials and colors mentioned in the fulfillment in chapter 40.
Describes the actual making of the curtain for the entrance of the tabernacle, which Moses now sets up.
God's command to Moses to set up the curtain at the entrance of the tabernacle, which is now carried out.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included the curtain at the entrance of the tabernacle, showing the continued significance of this curtain.
Both verses document the same setup sequence where the curtain establishes the boundary of the holy area toward the entrance.
The verses describe the same event from different angles: 40:21 introduces the ark behind the curtain, while 40:28 confirms the placement of this curtain at the entrance to the sanctuary.
Connects the curtain at the gate of the courtyard (40:8) with the curtain at the entrance of the tabernacle (40:28) to illustrate the double separation of the holy place.
Shows continuity from the Tent of Meeting to the Temple: both have an innermost room specifically furnished to house the ark of the covenant behind a curtain.
